editionLabel: Blue Orange English base game · copyright 2016
firstPlayerRule: During setup, draw kings blindly one at a time and place each on an available domino. Once play begins, the owner of the king on the lowest-numbered domino takes the first turn.
clarifications: The initial king placement and the first regular turn are different steps.
At two players, each person has two kings. Later turn order follows the domino positions, rather than clockwise seating.
interpretation: A separate random starting-player draw does not replace the king-and-domino setup in this edition.
